EMBERFALL

The Ember Wards have failed. Five dungeons stir. Take up arms.

Controls

  • Left click — move / attack (hold to keep moving)
  • Right click (hold) — raise shield. Raising it just before a hit parries it.
  • Space — roll (i-frames). 1–6 — skills. A / S — drink potion.
  • E — interact (chests, shops, portals). Tab / I / K / M — panels.
